title: a-refused-boat-goes-to-fixme-not-to-the-trouble-store
intention: When harbor_master's clearance refuses a boat's crossing to PROVED because its proof does not cover it, the boat takes a back-edge into FIXME carrying the list of what it is missing, and no trouble is raised in the operator's store.
why: Akien, verbatim (relayed in ~/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md item 1, 2026-10-01): "whoever asked is the ticket itself. recording the refusal is not important to furthering anything. yes it becomes open work. But where?" / "it becomes open work in deisgn. it goes back to ticketing for improvement." / "FIXME. that's approved thru PROVED"
traces_to: The 2026-08-10 ruling decisions/2026-08-10-the-ticket-owns-the-refusal: "the gate is the refuser but it's doing so on behalf of the ticket. so the ticket owns the refusal." / "the ticket owns the workflow". Law 6: the harbor raises nothing about boats he does not own. Law 7: the refusal stays permanent in the crossing's history record.
how: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py rung 2b: on coverage lacks, emit the back-edge emit(workflow_str, 'FIXME', history_path, state_path, ticket=boat_id, actor=..., missing=<the lacks>) at the crossing's own address, write the boat's ticket (workflow_and_state = the returned string, fixme = one entry per lack) through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write in the world _crossing_roots() names (the live commons when it returns None), then raise Uncovered naming FIXME. Delete _raise_uncovered_trouble and the trouble_device parameter from _decide and clear. Clear the troubles boat-crossed-to-proved-uncovered-{cfa17e00b0a7, 68f563403c8f, c691e19d5464} and close a-live-fire-proof-manufactures-troubles-in-the-operators-store. Proved by teeth added to cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance.py.
falsifier: RED if: (1) a fixture boat refused at PROVED for a coverage lack does not land at FIXME with every lack in its ticket's fixme list and in the back-edge's journaled missing; (2) any trouble is raised by the refusal; (3) a fixture refusal writes anything under the live CairnCommons/tickets or CairnCommons/troubles; (4) the boat cannot leave FIXME for BUILDME while a missing item is unanswered. Horizon: the tester seal.
watchme: none, because every real refusal now lands as a FIXME cursor on the refused ticket in CairnCommons/tickets, which the operator inbox and /sail already read; a refusal that fails to land shows as a ticket still at PROVEME after a refused crossing in its component's history.json
children: none, because the change is one rung in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py plus its proof
builder_notes: Correction to the /intent berth: cfa17e00b0a7 has no ticket in the LIVE CairnCommons/tickets because its ticket lives in test_codemother's fixture world; the refusal reached rung 2b there and raised its trouble in the live store. So the back-edge's ticket write must resolve the ticket in the same world _crossing_roots() names (roots['commons']/tickets in a fixture, CairnCommons/tickets live), exactly as boat_owner_of resolved it. Load-bearing: only Uncovered at PROVED is a design lack; Unauthorized, GrantExpired, Unresourced and Unproven keep raising unchanged. A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which refusals? Only rung 2b (coverage lacks at PROVED). (2) Order? emit the back-edge to FIXME at the caller's history_path/state_path with ticket=boat_id, actor=actor, missing=lacks; then write the ticket; then raise Uncovered whose message names FIXME and every lack. (3) Ticket write? path = the single tickets/<boat_id>-*.json under (roots['commons'] if roots else COMMONS root); doc['workflow_and_state'] = the emitted string; doc['fixme'] = [{'n': i, 'kind': lack['kind'], 'missing': lack['why']} for i, lack in enumerate(lacks, 1)]; written with cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<boat_id>: clearance refused at PROVED — sent to FIXME with <n> missing'). (4) No history_path? A clearance call without history_path journals nothing today, so the back-edge is computed with emit and no paths and still written to the ticket. (5) Troubles? cleared through the trouble device's clear verb, by='cc', what_changed naming this ticket.

decisions.text: Folded in, measured 2026-10-01 at the pre-commit reseal of cairn 4a38b2ed: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance.py's covered-crossing tooth (the block at lines ~877-921 using _OTHER_BOAT = 'an-intention-declares-its-gated-hands') crosses a LIVE ticket to PROVED, so the exit gate's lane the_stones_are_pushed reads the real CairnCommons and reds whenever it has unpushed commits (red before the push of d5f5692, green after, no code change). Since this ticket already rewrites test_clearance's refusal teeth, the same build makes that tooth cross inside a fixture world: run it under a _crossing_roots() fixture whose commons is a scratch git repo with no unpushed commits (or a stubbed upstream equal to HEAD), so the tooth's verdict cannot depend on the operator's push state. RED if after the build the tooth's result changes when the live CairnCommons has an unpushed commit.

MEASURED 2026-10-01: _crossing_roots is NOT a pytest fixture; it is a module-level zero-argument function in clearance.py:971 returning None (live world) or {repo, commons, instance}. The proof substitutes it with the context manager _fixture_journals() at test_clearance.py:1544-1554, which swaps _clearance._crossing_roots for a lambda naming _journal_world() and restores it. The covered-crossing tooth (_OTHER_BOAT, ~877-921) is isolated by running its clear() under _fixture_journals() with _t._TICKETS patched to _FIXTURE_TICKETS and the boat cast via _cast(_OTHER_BOAT), the pattern _refuse_at_proved already uses; the tooth asserts the ticket it crossed sits under the fixture world, not COMMONS_ROOT.

MEASURED: the trouble device's public CLI verb is 'cairn trouble clear <id> --what-changed <what> [--by <who>]' (TroubleDevice.clear(identity, *, by, what_changed), trouble.py:231). After PROVED run, for each tid: cairn trouble clear boat-crossed-to-proved-uncovered-<tid> --what-changed '973574dddb77: a coverage refusal lands at FIXME and raises no trouble' --by cc; then the same for a-live-fire-proof-manufactures-troubles-in-the-operators-store. Operator action through the device's public interface (RULE 1), not part of the build or its proofs.
decisions.step: unlisted: Clear the three specified troubles (cfa17e00b0a7, 68f563403c8f, c691e19d5464) via the trouble device's clear verb

decisions.text: MEASURED: rung 2b is clearance.py:1351 'if fold(canon_target(parse_workflow(workflow_str), target)) == "proved":', computing _lacks via _coverage_lacks; line 1355 calls _raise_uncovered_trouble (def at 1026), then raises Uncovered (class at 300) — the correct exception, its message gains a sentence naming FIXME. actor, boat_id, history_path, state_path are keyword parameters of _decide (1060-1075) and clear (1422-1437). The build replaces line 1355 with _sent = _send_to_fixme(workflow_str, boat_id, _lacks, actor=actor, history_path=history_path, state_path=state_path): emit(workflow_str, 'FIXME', missing=['[kind] why' per lack], ticket=boat_id, actor=actor, ...); resolve the ticket under _crossing_roots()['commons']/tickets (TICKETS_DIR when it returns None); artifact.write workflow_and_state + fixme=[{n, kind, missing}]. It never raises: a boat whose class has no FIXME (repair_summons, today only code-seam@v2) or whose ticket does not resolve stays where it is, and the returned sentence says why inside the Uncovered message. trouble_device is removed from _decide, clear, and the call between them (1483).
decisions.step: unlisted: Implement FIXME back-edge in harbor_master/clearance.py rung 2b (emit + ticket write + Uncovered raise), delete _raise_uncovered_trouble function, and remove trouble_device parameter

decisions.text: MEASURED: the teeth are ALREADY written red in the working tree (test_clearance.py, PROVES 973574dddb77 clauses 1-4): _refuse_at_proved(tid) casts a fixture ticket via _fixme_world_ticket, seals an uncovered proof, patches _insp._CHART_BERTHS, _t._TICKETS=_FIXTURE_TICKETS and _diagnostic.ModuleRaiser=_CountingModuleRaiser, and calls clear(_FIXME_WF, 'PROVED', ...) under _owner_is(_covered_owner) and _fixture_journals() — the same shape as the existing _cross_to_proved refusal teeth. Measured pre-build: all four RED, the covered tooth GREEN. The build deletes the two trouble teeth (test_a_REFUSAL_RAISES_A_TROUBLE..., test_a_TROUBLE_STORE_THAT_IS_DOWN...) which pass trouble_device, their checks-list entries, and the comment mention near line 71.
